headline: Fresenius Medical Care Cuts Full-Year Outlook Despite Q3 Earnings Beat
summary: Fresenius Medical Care reported a third-quarter earnings beat but still cut its forward financial outlook.
why: Lowered forward guidance often outweighs historical earnings beats, shifting market expectations for future profitability.

impacts.name: Fresenius Medical Care
impacts.why: A reduced forward outlook directly degrades future earnings expectations, lowering equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A lowered forward outlook overshadowed Q3 earnings results, reducing investor confidence in future growth.
